name: Kettlebell Single-Arm Floor Press
steps: Lie faceup with feet flat, one upper arm on the floor and the kettlebell resting against the back of that forearm.
Brace your core and extend your free arm out to the side on the floor for stability.
Press the kettlebell straight up over your chest until your elbow locks out, keeping your wrist completely straight.
Lower your upper arm slowly back until it touches the floor gently, and switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep your elbow angled roughly 45 degrees from your ribs instead of flaring straight out.
Pause lightly when your triceps touches the floor rather than bouncing off the ground.
